terms.AI model: The 'brain' file the AI uses to understand and answer you. Bigger ones are smarter but need more memory.
terms.local: Runs on your own PC. Your words are not sent to any company.
terms.GPU: A graphics card. It can run AI much faster than the main processor.
terms.VRAM: The graphics card's own memory. More of it lets you run a bigger, smarter AI quickly.
terms.RAM: Your PC's short-term memory. The AI must fit in it (or in VRAM) while it works.
terms.CPU: The main processor in your PC. It can run AI too, just more slowly than a graphics card.
terms.disk space: Storage on your PC where files are kept. The AI model is saved here once.
terms.parameters: A rough measure of an AI's size, like '7B' for 7 billion. More usually means smarter and slower.
terms.quantization: Shrinking an AI model so it fits on normal PCs, with a small loss in quality.
terms.Q4: A common shrunk size for AI models. About a quarter of the original, still good quality.
terms.context: How much text the AI can keep in mind at once, like the length of its short-term memory.
terms.token: A short piece of text, often a whole word or part of one, that the AI reads and writes.
terms.tokens per second: How fast the AI writes. About 5 feels slow, 20 or more feels quick.
terms.Ollama: A free program that runs AI models on your PC. SetupPilot installs it for you.
terms.llama.cpp: Another free program for running AI models. Used only for the optional speed boost.
terms.API: A way for programs to talk to each other. Your coding tool uses it to reach the AI.
terms.localhost: An address that means 'this PC'. Only programs on your own PC can use it.
terms.Tailscale: A free app that makes a private network between your own devices, so they can reach each other safely.
terms.winget: Windows' built-in app installer. SetupPilot uses it to install programs safely.
terms.admin rights: Permission to install programs on this PC. Windows asks you to confirm.
terms.speculative decoding: A trick where a small AI guesses ahead and a bigger AI checks, so answers come faster.
terms.estimate: Our best guess before testing. The real number is measured after the test run.
terms.manifest: SetupPilot's list of everything it changed, so it can undo all of it later.
terms.coding tool: A program that helps you write code, like an AI pair programmer.
